name: Saint Mary's College
academic_ranking: Private Catholic women's liberal arts college. U.S. News 2026: #84 of 207 National Liberal Arts Colleges (was #80 in 2025). Also cited among Best Value Schools (~#42-46) and strong on social mobility. Acceptance rate ~87%.
financial_aid: As an NCAA Division III program there are no athletic scholarships; all aid is need- and merit-based academic aid. Roughly 96% of students receive some form of financial aid. Room ~$10,234 and board ~$5,814 additional; a general semester fee (~$1,194) also applies. School promotes a Net Price Calculator and notes actual cost varies by aid awarded. (Tuition figure ~$55,552 for 2026-27; verify with Student Accounts Office.)
facilities_notes: Softball is part of the Saint Mary's Belles athletics program. Athletics facilities reference the Purcell Athletic Fields on the Notre Dame, IN campus. No detailed softball-specific facility description was published on the roster/coaches pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: Division III program competing in the MIAA. Rebuilding under head coach Jordyn Walter (hired Aug 2024). Prior 2024 season record was 10-22 (5-11 MIAA), missing the conference tournament. Team account: @Belles_Softball.
notes: Saint Mary's College is a women's college; the athletics brand is the 'Belles.' Official athletics site resolves to belles.saintmarys.edu (the saintmarysbelles.com host was unreachable when checked 2026-07). Do not confuse with Saint Mary's College of California (Gaels) or St. Mary's University (Rattlers). Roster size 19 taken from the 2026 softball roster page. Head coach Jordyn Walter is a Western Michigan University graduate who previously assisted at Lake Michigan College.
